page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-48-lssd is an arm64-based server instance powered by the ARMv8 Neoverse-V2 processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores operating at 3.0 GHz, with one thread per core. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. It includes a bundled local storage configuration of 4020 GB across NVMe SSDs, and does not include any GPUs.

In benchmark testing, the c4a-standard-48-lssd demonstrates strong multi-core performance, achieving a top-tier score in Geekbench multi-core testing and software compilation with Clang. Its memory subsystem shows high efficiency, with Passmark memory scores and database operations ranking in the top tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and static web serving throughput also perform in the top tier, reaching 97.21 GB/sec. Single-core benchmarks, such as stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core, fall into the average category.

From a resource density perspective, the instance offers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio combined with high-capacity local NVMe storage, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring both high-speed local scratch space and multi-core processing. The server is well-suited for database operations, software compilation, static web serving, and multi-threaded data compression tasks.
